study: Ansari & Pianta 2018 — NCRECE MyTeachingPartner (MTP) web-mediated coaching, cluster RCT, Pre-K language/literacy
delivery_evidence: The coded contrast is the MTP coaching arm: teachers video-record an instructional activity, send it biweekly to a coach who web-mediates feedback (clips + prompts on a website), then a videoconference discusses it; ~10 coaching cycles/yr — all remote/web-mediated (Method, intervention paragraph; described as 'web-mediated' PD).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are independent norm-referenced standardized instruments (PPVT-III receptive vocab, WJ-III expressive vocab, TOPEL phonological awareness/print knowledge) not tailored to the intervention (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 2 main-effect model).
curriculum_evidence: MTP coaching focuses on improving teachers' teacher-child interactions (instructional/emotional support); content-/curriculum-independent PD coaching with no new curriculum or materials package adopted (intro/Method; 'PD coaching intervention that focuses on teachers' interactions').
outcome_timing_evidence: Child outcomes measured in spring at the end of the preschool intervention year (extraction timepoint=spring/post, end of preschool year); no delayed follow-up wave used.
